info.name: SGITU - G10 Gateway x G7 Suivi Vehicules
info.description: Tests Postman complets pour verifier la relation G10 -> G7. G10 valide le JWT, applique le RBAC G7, propage X-User-Id/X-User-Email/X-Roles/X-Correlation-Id et route /api/suivi-vehicules/** vers G7.

exec: const payload = { sub: email, userId: String(userId), roles: roles, iat: now, exp: now + ttlSeconds, jti: 'g7-postman-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) };

item.name: 00.2 - 200 health G7 via G10 avec ROLE_OPERATOR

exec: pm.test('G7 health route via G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('JWT absent bloque par G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('JWT invalide bloque par G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('JWT expire bloque par G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('ROLE_PASSENGER refuse par G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('ROLE_OPERATOR peut lire G7', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('ROLE_TECHNICIAN peut lire les stats alertes', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('ROLE_DRIVER ne cree pas vehicule', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('Alias vehicles protege par G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('Vehicule cree via G10 -> G7', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('Vehicule retrouve via G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Statut vehicule mis a jour', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('ROLE_OPERATOR ne cree pas position GPS', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('Position creee via G10 -> G7', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('Position actuelle lue via G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Alertes actives lues via G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('ROLE_TECHNICIAN ne modifie pas alerte', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('Route cancel alerte atteinte sans blocage G10', function () { pm.expect([200, 400, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
